_note: Optional model overrides for this river. Any key you delete falls back to the default in live_data.py / engine.py.
_flow_dir: 1 = chainage 0+000 (near Sangam) is the upstream end, as in the 10 m chainage KML
_dwf: urban dry-weather inflow per km of river (STP outfalls + nallas), m3/s. ASSUMED - replace with PMC STP discharge data
_bank_height_m: add  "bank_height_m": 4.5  (one value) or a list with one value per km (17 values) to replace the DEM-estimated bank heights with surveyed embankment levels (m above the survey-day water surface)
_slope: add  "slope": 0.0004  to override the DEM water-surface slope
